name: mirofish-ar-fintech-sim
description: Argentina fintech behavior simulation platform adapted from MiroFish

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.dev:next: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend-next -c green,cyan "npm run backend" "npm run frontend:next"
